This game is a pathetic money grab. Here's why:
1. The servers that host this game are terrible. Before its most recent update, it was practically unplayable during the week. Weekends were a bit better but still its unpleasant to play a jittery game, A friend and I couldn't pass the first 3 stages because we would lag so much that it would kick us out the mission and there's no reconnecting to a person that's already in a game. So we ended up doing it over and over again hoping that it wouldn't kick us out, I mean Aliens have a huge head hit box. If I am struggling to hit it because of lag then there's definitely something wrong with the game.
2. This game doesn't believe in cinematic or facial character animations. The story (if I can call it that) is uninteresting and pointless. (No facial animations add to the boringness). I can get over that they didn't have enough money to do animations but at least do a beginning or an ending. The ending to this game (I would say spoiler alert but there's nothing to spoil) literally ends. No animation to show you destroyed the hive. Not even a "Thank you for playing". Nothing! Just a black screen and you are returned to the main menu. Complete waste of time and money.
3. The combat was fun but the classes don't make sense. The medic for example has the ability to deploy a healing area that can heal you and your teammates to full. However the thing doesn't recharge when you don't use it so you have to plan when to use it, If its depletable then why is it not an item? What I am saying is the game requires me to pick a class where I can get the 1 use per level ability and restricted access to all the weapons because I chose that class.
Bonus. For some strange reason, the confirm-kill sound for a headshot on an alien sounds like a race car on a motorway. Its funny the first few times but then it gets annoying later on in the game. Someone messed up in that department.

On a whole. Use your money on finished games like World War Z or Left for Dead or Dark Tide

I like this game, it's good fun for a few hours. It's best played with friends, but even then it can get repetitive quickly. There's only 12 missions (15 with the expansion) and it doesn't take long at all before you know more-or-less how each one plays out. This means you have to play them over and over again if you want all of the weapons, attachments, perk cards etc.

If your friends get bored, then you get stuck in solo play with very bad bot teammates that can't handle any difficulty above Standard. You need mods to make them better if you want to play harder difficulties.

The DLC outside of the Expansion is 99.9% cosmetic, with only a single weapon. None of the DLC weapons are super OP, so it's not pay-to-win in any regard.

One last thing to note is the very annoying updates this game gets. It is literally quicker to uninstall and redownload the game than it is to let the game patch itself sometimes. Not everytime, but the fact that it happens at all is beyond belief.
This game is so much fun, definitely recommend.  Only complaint is that it takes a while to matchmake.

An excellent three person co-op shooter, that hits the right balance of scary, fast-paced, and tactical, with a bit of mayhem thrown in at times. The different classes and weapon choices are diverse enough for some decent replayability. The third person combat is well executed and the diving and rolling mechanic keeps the battles quite fast and intense. The missions are diverse and full of Alien and Prometheus environments and lore, which like the narrative is ever present but not too intrusive. Had an issue connecting with one friend in another region, who despite our efforts we couldn't play with, but apart from that it's been pretty seamless with no big bugs or crashes. 
Overall it's a great blast - if you like the idea of a scarier Left 4 Dead with Aliens for three players then this is the game for you!
